hooks.name: Tasks status update on file create
hooks.description: Updates task status in tasks.md when files are created

action.prompt: A source file from the mcp-context-manager project was just created or modified. Consult .kiro/specs/mcp-context-manager/tasks.md and check off sub-tasks that correspond to files now present in src/. Only check a task if you are certain its implementation is complete — when in doubt, do not check.
